summary: The repository directly extends the upgraded webpack preset, and version 2 requires TypeScript 5 because it enables verbatim module syntax.

findings.title: Compile with the TypeScript 5 preset
findings.impact: The root TypeScript configuration inherits the package's webpack preset, so the version 2 TypeScript 5 and verbatim-module-syntax requirement applies directly to this build configuration.
recommendedChecks: Run the existing TypeScript lint and webpack compilation with TypeScript 5, checking for imports that must be marked type-only under verbatim module syntax.
